title: SignWallet
tagline: This Web3 wallet, powered by Layer Zero, provides a seamless multi-chain experience with built-in cross-chain bridging, allowing users to manage assets, view balances, and interact with NFTs across various blockchains.
description:
The project is a next-generation Web3 wallet built to provide a seamless onboarding experience for non-crypto users while delivering advanced functionality for experienced users. This wallet combines an intuitive interface with powerful Web3 technologies, offering a one-stop solution for managing digital assets, bridging across multiple blockchains, and interacting with decentralized applications (dApps).

Core Features and Technologies:
User-Friendly Interface and Onboarding:

Customizable UI: Users can personalize their experience by adjusting the interface to their preferences, with light/dark mode, customizable layouts, and quick access shortcuts for frequent actions.
Multi-Chain Support and Cross-Chain Bridging:

Unified Asset Management: Users can view their complete portfolio in a single dashboard, showing real-time balances across all supported blockchains. The wallet's multi-chain functionality simplifies the management of diverse digital assets and eliminates the need to switch between different wallets or platforms.
Chainlink Price Feeds: Real-time price data is fetched using Chainlink’s decentralized oracle network, ensuring accurate and reliable information for all supported assets. This allows users to track the value of their holdings with confidence and provides transparency during token swaps or transactions.
Decentralized Communication:

XMTP Integration for Secure Chat: The wallet includes a built-in decentralized chat feature powered by the XMTP (Extensible Message Transport Protocol), allowing users to communicate securely with other wallet users. This enhances community building and engagement within the wallet ecosystem, enabling features like P2P trading discussions, DAO governance communication, and direct messaging for customer support.
Privacy and Security in Communication: Messages are encrypted end-to-end, ensuring that all communications remain private and secure. Users have full control over who can contact them and can manage their chat preferences directly from the wallet.
Enhanced Security Measures:

Comprehensive Wallet Dashboard:

Portfolio Overview: Displays a detailed breakdown of assets across multiple chains, including token balances, historical performance charts, and NFT collections with metadata.
Transaction History: Users can easily view and filter their transaction history, including cross-chain transfers, swaps, staking activities, NFT mints, and more. The dashboard provides detailed transaction analytics, such as fees paid, price at the time of the transaction, and asset performance post-transaction.
NFT Gallery: A visually rich gallery for managing NFTs across various supported chains, with the ability to view, send, or sell directly from the wallet. Metadata, rarity rankings, and market prices are also displayed.
Integrated dApp Browser: Sign protocol is used for attestation of credibility of a website
how_its_made: This Web3 wallet is designed to onboard non-crypto users with its intuitive, user-friendly interface and seamless experience. It leverages Web3Auth for easy login with familiar social accounts, making the transition to Web3 smooth for newcomers. The wallet integrates Chainlink to provide real-time asset prices, while Layer Zero enables secure and cost-efficient cross-chain bridging. Additionally, it features XMTP for decentralized chat functionality, allowing users to communicate securely within the wallet. Unlike traditional wallets like MetaMask, this wallet offers an all-in-one solution that combines simplicity, advanced features, and enhanced security, making it perfect for both beginners and experienced users in the blockchain space.
